tools.name: spin_wheel
tools.description: Pick one or more winners at random from a list of names or options, and show the wheel spinning to the result in the chat. Use it whenever the person wants something chosen at random: a student to answer, who goes first, where to eat, a raffle winner among friends. Works without an account. The pick

tools.name: make_teams
tools.description: Split a list of names into random teams or groups of even size, and show them as cards in the chat. Use it for class groups, project teams, game sides, rotations. Give either how many teams or how many people per team. Works without an account.

tools.name: open_wheel_link
tools.description: Make a namewheel.org link that opens the full NameWheel wheel with these names already loaded, for spinning on a projector, a stream or a shared screen with sound, modes and themes. Works without an account. Commas inside a name become spaces in the link.

tools.name: certified_draw
tools.description: Run a TrueSpin certified draw on NameWheel: the winner is sealed by NameWheel's server before it is revealed, randomness from this connection is added, and the result is published on a permanent public proof page (namewheel.org/v/CODE) that anyone can check, with a button that recomputes the draw. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_draw" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spin_wheel, make_teams · Private data: spin_wheel, verify_draw · Public sink: certified_draw · Destructive: certified_draw, freeze_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spin_wheel, make_teams · Private data: spin_wheel, verify_draw · Public sink: certified_draw · Destructive: certified_draw, freeze_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
